newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela cenbank to issue dollar bonds by yearend.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela cenbank to issue dollar bonds by yearend.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank will start using dollar-backed Treasury bills alongside its TEMs to conduct monetary policy by the end of the year, Bank President Antonio Casas Gonzalez said, according to state news agency Venpres.

Casas added the dollar-backed T-bills would slowly be substituted for bolivar-denominated debt through 1997. However, both types of paper would be used alongside the Bank's monetary stabilization notes, called TEMs, that currently bear the brunt of monetary policy.

The T-bills form part of the government's complex strategy to pay-off its $3.9 billion debt with the Central Bank. Implementation of the strategy is waiting on expected approval by the Senate later this month of the government's plan.
